existing.description: The UQ International Excellence Scholarship is a 25% reduction in tuition fees per semester awarded to high-achieving international students commencing a full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program at The University of Queensland in 2027. There is no separate application: UQ states "You don't need to apply for this scholarship. When you apply to study a program at UQ, you're automatically assessed for this scholarship." Offers are issued with the unconditional offer letter or once all conditions of a conditional offer are met, and the reduction is applied before the tuition fee due date each semester. The number of awards may vary, and the scholarship is valid only for the program and commencement semester named in the offer letter.
eligibility: Have applied to study full-time at UQ commencing in 2027 in an eligible program
Have satisfied all the conditions of the program offer
Have satisfied the program entry rank and English language proficiency requirements
Have achieved a competitive score as determined by the University among the pool of offer holders for programs in their commencement semester
Not have received another scholarship, tuition fee reduction or rebate from UQ (excluding the UQ English Language Scholarship)
Not have received a full scholarship or sponsorship from another organisation; applicants with partial scholarships or sponsorships may be considered
existing.eligibility_summary: International students who have applied to study full-time at UQ in an eligible program commencing in 2027, have satisfied all conditions of the program offer, have satisfied the program entry rank and English language proficiency requirements, and have achieved a competitive score as determined by the University among the pool of offer holders for programs in their commencement semester. Applicants must not have received another scholarship, tuition fee reduction or rebate from UQ (excluding the UQ English Language Scholarship), nor a full scholarship or sponsorship from another organisation.
benefits: 25% tuition fee reduction applied prior to the tuition fees due date each semester
Reduction applies for the duration of the enrolled program
coverage: 25% reduction in tuition fees per semester
requirements: Full-time enrolment in an eligible program in the commencement semester named in the offer

documents: Evidence of satisfying the program entry rank requirement
existing.english_requirement: Must have satisfied the program entry rank and English language proficiency requirements.

existing.selection_notes: Applicants must have achieved a competitive score as determined by the University among the pool of offer holders for programs in their commencement semester. The number of scholarships awarded may vary.
